svg.title: AI Solution Decision Framework
svg.desc: Decision tree. Start from the business problem. If it is structured and rules-based, use RPA or Logic Apps. Otherwise, if it does not require language understanding, use traditional ML or Azure ML. If it does not need multi-step reasoning, use Copilot Studio single-turn. If it does not need autonomous tool use, use Azure OpenAI with prompt flow. If it does, use agentic AI with the AI Foundry Agent Service.
svg.text: Ask the questions in order; stop at the first answer that fits.
